description: How to retire a given tCO2e amount for real, on-chain, via the Klima rail — paid keyless from the caller's own wallet, returning a confirmed retire transaction as the certificate. Returns instructions and the exact door; this server never performs the retirement and never holds a wallet. The retirement is real; any footprint number behind it stays orientation, never a precise carbon claim.

amount_tco2e.description: Tonnes of CO2e to retire, e.g. 0.005.

beneficiary_name.description: Optional name to record on the retirement.

retirement_message.description: Optional message to record on the retirement.

name: retire_and_certify
title: Retire carbon on-chain and get the certificate
